title.narrative: Strengthening the Power of Youth Voices Quarterly Progress Report: October 2025 - December 2025

description.narrative: The project sustained structured platforms that enabled youth engagement with governance institutions and political actors. These included party branch–building forums, intergenerational dialogues, online engagements and national-level policy engagement spaces such as the launch of the National Youth Manifesto. Through these platforms, youth enhanced their capacity to articulate civic concerns, engage duty bearers, and undertake coordinated, evidence-based advocacy at both county and national levels. Digital engagement remained a key strategy for amplifying youth voices and promoting accountability. Social media campaigns and leadership accountability initiatives reached over 57,131 people during the quarter, supporting youth-led monitoring of service delivery and governance commitments. These efforts contributed to tangible governance outcomes, with youth and community-based organizations successfully following up on priority issues. As a result, 5 civic and governance concerns were addressed, including improvements in public infrastructure, health service access, environmental sanitation, and youth policy development at county level. The project also recorded progress in strengthening the legitimacy and capacity of youth civic actors. Community-based organizations continued to lead advocacy follow-up actions with increasing independence, demonstrating growing sustainability of youth-led accountability efforts. At the same time, the quarter highlighted uneven levels of uptake across counties and financial constraints affecting some partners, informing a stronger focus on mentorship, peer learning, and local resource mobilization going forward. Deliberate efforts were made to promote inclusion, with active participation of young women and persons with disabilities across engagement platforms evident by the ratio of men:women at 47.05%:52.95%. To support long-term sustainability, the project further transitioned advocacy skills, monitoring approaches, and follow-up mechanisms to community partners, reinforced through continued capacity building, inter-county learning, and an open mentorship framework.
